transcript.text: Hi, we've just had a Bosch KGN36VLEAG delivered last week and it makes a gurgling, bubbling sound like water running, plus a click every so often and a crack noise at night. Is it faulty? It's driving my husband mad.

It is probably not faulty. The gurgling and bubbling sounds you hear are the refrigerant circulating through the cooling pipes—this is exactly what it should sound like when the fridge is running. The clicking noise is likely the compressor switching on or off, which happens automatically to maintain temperature. The cracking or popping noises at night are very common in new appliances (and plastic components generally) as they expand and contract with changing temperatures. Since your Bosch was delivered last week, it may also be working harder than usual to cool down from room temperature for the first time. As long as the fridge and freezer sections are getting cold and there is no oily residue around the back of the unit, these noises are normal behaviour.

candidates: Normal operation (refrigerant flow and thermal expansion) (high)

reading.symptom: gurgling, bubbling sound like water running, click every so often, crack noise at night

plan: They asked: "Is it faulty?" - answer that first.
Already given by the customer, never ask for it again: make Bosch; model KGN36VLEAG.
The fault they reported is: "gurgling, bubbling sound like water running, click every so often, crack noise at night". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply. Do not tell them to buy, order or replace a part yet.
